1.consolidated_definition: Juego infantil que se hace con un aro, consistente en sostenerlo moviendo el torso para evitar que caiga al suelo.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Aerial or Torso Balance Game 

Game played by children with a hoop, consisting in holding it while moving the torso to avoid letting it fall to the ground.
